title: Wire the tested D18 tutored-mirror-wipe fix (resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe / wipeRevokedMirrors) into the real incoming-grants reconcile path, or delete it
rule: AG-6 dead code / Evans: invariant re-derived instead of enforced once

evidence.quote: /// D18 fix: resolve the owning account id directly from the [accounts] table

why: resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe exists solely to feed TutoredMirrorWipeService.wipeRevokedMirrors the tutor's real accounts.id instead of currentAccountIdProvider, which the docstring and test/sync/tutored_wipe_wrong_id_test.dart both claim 'during an active TUTORED session can resolve to the talmid's learner_profiles.id,' causing a revoked tutor's mirrored talmid data to silently survive (a real child-privacy concern if true). Grepping lib/ and test/ shows resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe and wipeRevokedMirrors have zero callers anywhere except that one regression test — the fix was built and unit-tested but never wired into production. The actual revoke-reconcile path that runs today (incomingTutorGrantsProvider in features/tutoring/presentation/providers/manage_tutors_providers.dart:97/109) instead reconciles via `ref.watch(currentAccountIdProvider)` directly plus a per-grant wipeMirrorForGrant loop — the exact pattern the D18 docstring calls unsafe. Tracing currentAccountIdProvider (profile_providers.dart) and AuthStateNotifier (auth_state_provider.dart) shows currentUser is derived purely from the live Firebase uid + accounts/user_profiles lookup, with no dependency on activeProfileIdProvider or tutored-session selection — so the documented failure mode may no longer be reachable, meaning the D18 docstring/test could simply be stale. Either way, the tested fix and the shipped code have diverged and nobody has reconciled them.
recommendation: Determine whether incomingTutorGrantsProvider's currentAccountIdProvider-based reconcile is actually safe now (it appears to be, since currentAccountIdProvider no longer varies with tutored-session state). If safe, delete resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe/wipeRevokedMirrors and retire or rewrite tutored_wipe_wrong_id_test.dart to test the real path. If not safe (i.e. there's a code path where currentAccountIdProvider does vary during a tutored session), call resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe from incomingTutorGrantsProvider instead of its current inline resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Either incomingTutorGrantsProvider routes through resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe/wipeRevokedMirrors, or resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe and wipeRevokedMirrors are deleted along with their now-inaccurate docstrings.
grep -rn 'resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe\|wipeRevokedMirrors(' outside test/ is non-empty if kept, or the symbols no longer exist if removed.
tutored_wipe_wrong_id_test.dart is updated to exercise whichever path is actually shipped.
